title: Muc-Off is Giving Away Grand Theft Auto VI on a PS5 Pro & a Big Bike Care Bundle
content:
Look, this is an obvious attention grab. Yes, it’s just Muc-Off trying to attract eyeballs (and collect email addresses). No, this is not a paid or sponsored post. But come on…

One lucky person is going to win a Sony PlayStation 5 Pro, a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI – the buzziest video game launch in a decade, probably – and a killer bundle of Muc-Off’s own gear to clean, lube & protect your bike through the winter.

Muc-Off Grand Theft Auto VI & bike care giveaway

Thirteen years since its last launch, Grand Theft Auto VI has literally been all over my newsfeed this week. I’ll be honest, I think I might have last played GTA 3 or 4, and I’m not likely to sit down to play GTA VI any time soon. But the buzz is real. The graphics and deep backstories seem legit. And a lot of cyclists are probably down with spending some virtual time in Vice City when cold & wet weather outside might be keeping them off the bike.

So here it is.

Muc-Off is running a random giveaway of a mega prize package. The contest is open world wide (+/- a few countries that don’t like this sort of thing). One entrant will take the whole shebang.

Everyone who enters will still get a promo code that will give you an extra 6% off discount on top of Muc-Off’s regular 25% off Black Friday deals. No purchase necessary, and you don’t even need to opt into their newsletter to get the bonus code. You just have to be over 18 years old, give them your email, and enter by next Friday.

Enter here.

Good luck. And if one of our readers wins, we want to hear about it in the comments!

What all is up for grabs?

  • a copy of GTA VI, standard edition for PS5
  • Sony PlayStation 5 Pro with disc drive & 1 standard controller
  • Muc-Off Mobile Pressure Washer Ultimate Bundle with all the goodies
    (Mobile Pressure Washer w/ battery & charger; 2nd 40V battery; 3 cleaning + Snow Foam lances; Nano Tech Cleaner 1l; extra Water Tank 20l; 65L Dry Bag Holdall; Nanotech Concentrate 1l)
  • Dark Energy Chain Wax Care kit
    (Dark Energy Chain Wax 120ml; Chain Wax Cleaner 500ml; Bicycle Chain Brush; Luxury Microfibre Cloth).
  • AirMach Pro electric mini inflator
  • 1× set of Big Bore Lite tubeless valves (your choice of color & length, pending availability; colour and length subject to stock).\
  • Bike Protect 500ml spray

author: Cory Benson
